events.content:
Build succeeded. Done. I added both custom fonts to `app/BlogHeader.tsx`, keeping all font loading and styling logic inside the component: - **Playfair Display** (weight 700) → applied to the main `

` heading - **Roboto** (weight 400) → applied to the subtitle `

` Both are loaded via `next/font/google`, which self-hosts the fonts at build time (no external network requests at runtime, automatic font fallback, and no layout shift). Each font exposes a CSS variable (`--font-playfair`, `--font-roboto`) applied through the header's className, with the actual `fontFamily` set inline on each element.
